tools.name: ygo_opening_hand_odds
tools.description: FREE Yu-Gi-Oh! opening hand odds for one card group. Chance to open at least N of a card or group (e.g. 12 starters) in 5 cards going first. For several groups at once and going second use ygo_combo_odds. (free, no payment)

tools.name: ygo_combo_odds
tools.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! draw/combo odds: starter + extender, bricks, hand traps. Exact draw/combo odds of opening a combination of card groups (e.g. 1+ starter AND 1+ extender AND at most 1 brick) going first (5 cards) and second (6 cards), up to 6 groups, any deck size 40-60. Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MPP

tools.name: ygo_handtrap_odds
tools.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! hand-trap odds (exact). Exact odds of opening at least one (or two) hand traps going first (5) and second (6). Pass a hand-trap count, or paste a .ydk and the known hand traps are auto-tagged. Also returns how many hand traps you need to hit 80% and 90%. Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MP

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ygo_hand_sim · Private data: ygo_deck_check, ygo_combo_odds, ygo_handtrap_odds, ygo_goldfish, ygo_hand_sim · Public sink: ygo_combo_odds, ygo_handtrap_odds, ygo_goldfish, ygo_hand_sim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ygo_hand_sim · Private data: ygo_deck_check, ygo_combo_odds, ygo_handtrap_odds, ygo_goldfish, ygo_hand_sim · Public sink: ygo_combo_odds, ygo_handtrap_odds, ygo_goldfish, ygo_hand_sim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
